notes.title: Kingdoms of Rhea's remake
notes.content:
Hello everyone !

It is with great pride that we announce the new version of Kingdoms of Rhea!

We have worked a lot to offer you this revisited and greatly improved version.

Here is the new trailer of the game : [previewyoutube=w6JBp-8rdP4;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]

We launched an [url=https://ulule.com/kingdom-of-rhea/]Ulule [/url]campaign to fund further development of Kingdoms of Rhea. Don't waste another second and help us finish this campaign!

The new version of Kingdoms of Rhea will include the following features:
- Multiplayer
- Crafting weapons / armor
- Mounts
- Character customization
- Dynamic gameplay
- Quests with tree of choice
- NPC companions
- and many other things!

Share Ulule and join our [url=https://discordapp.com/invite/XbwfUn2]discord[/url]!

Have a good day !

notes.title: Out of the alpha
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

The entire Kingdom of Rhea team is proud to announce that the game is finally available for free on steam!

Thank you all for your support, we look forward to your feedback on the game!

We will continue its development, and continue to add content as much as we can!

Once again, thank you all!

notes.title: Release date, update, content....
notes.content:
Good morning, everyone!

We arrive at the end of August, and Kingdom of Rhea will be out soon. We will be performing live this Friday, August 30th at 9pm on the channel: https://www.twitch.tv/vasrek in order to answer all your questions.

We will show you new content, we will talk about updates, upcoming shows, in short, you will know everything in detail!

We invite you all to come on live Friday in order not to miss any info!

Thank you all and see you on Friday!

notes.title: Extension of the release date
notes.content:
Good morning to everyone!

Kingdom of Rhea was supposed to be released on August 05, 2019 but we will not be able to provide this release.

We still plan to release the game at the end of August.

Thank you all for your understanding.

See you soon!
